what: Invalid or mis-projected geometry produces blank maps, points in the ocean and crashing area/union operations.

params: EPSG:4326 for GeoJSON; EPSG:3857 for web tiles
when: حين تظهر الخريطة فارغة أو النقاط في البحر أو تفشل عمليات المساحة والدمج بسبب هندسة غير صالحة / when maps come out blank, points land in the ocean or area/union fails due to invalid geometry

what: Measures speech level, noise floor, peak and SNR to decide gain, low-cut and compression.
how: AUD.measure: 50 ms RMS frames; noise = 15th percentile; speech = 70th percentile of frames > noise+8 dB; gain = clamp(-20 - speech, -12, 26); lowcut 120 Hz when SNR < 14 dB; comp = 0.45 or clamp((peak-speech)/30, 0.35, 0.8).
when: حين تريد ضبط صوت المتكلم بقياس مستوى الكلام والضوضاء ونسبة الإشارة لتحديد الكسب والقطع المنخفض والضغط / when deciding gain, low-cut and compression from measured speech level, noise floor and SNR

what: Counts hard cuts, average shot length, motion and still share of any reference video locally.
how: analyzeRef(): samples every 0.25 s (16-72), 40x40 luma frames; mean absolute diff; threshold = max(18, min(8*median, mean+1.8*sd)); returns cuts, avgShot, cutsPer10, still share (<0.5 diff), up to 8 JPEG key frames (512 px, q 0.8) for the model.
when: حين تريد معرفة عدد القطعات ومتوسط طول اللقطة ونسبة الثبات في فيديو مرجعي محليًا / when counting hard cuts, average shot length and still share of a reference video locally

what: A local study of a reference: frame-accurate cuts (hard cuts, whips, dissolves, white flashes, dips), per-shot camera moves from a motion field, palette and grade, caption band/size/colour/rate, per-second energy and beat alignment of cuts.
how: DNA.analyze: sample fps 8/6/4/2/1 by length (12-420 samples), 48x48 luma grid; every presented frame gets a 64-bin histogram; chi-square distance at two scales (frame-to-frame and ~0.25 s), threshold max(0.28, 7*p60); flash = brightness spike that returns; motionEst() searches scale +-0.02 and shift for global motion -> push/pull/pan/still/shake; textBands() finds dense horizontal-edge rows (>9% of row) for caption band; onBeat share of cuts.
when: حين تريد دراسة مرجع بعمق: أنواع الانتقالات وحركات الكاميرا والألوان وشكل الترجمة وتوافق القطع مع الإيقاع / for a deep reference study: transition types, camera moves, palette, captions and beat-aligned cuts

what: Renders the product through the same measurements and scores it against the reference, then closes the biggest gap.

when: حين تريد قياس مدى تشابه الفيديو الناتج مع المرجع ثم إصلاح أكبر فرق تلقائيًا / when scoring how close the product is to the reference and automatically closing the biggest gap

what: Do not let an animated stat claim a change that sampling noise can explain; attach an interval or say 'not yet distinguishable'.

Verdict: ship (no programmatic issues and all >=4), revise (fixable issues or any 3), block (any 1-2 or unreadable text). One targeted change per iteration, stop at ship or after 3 iterations.

how: Decode each frame to a 384-px-wide grey grid (ffmpeg rawvideo). mad = mean |Δluma|; blockmax = max mean |Δluma| over 12×12 blocks. OUTLIER: min(dAB, dBC) > 3 and ≥ 2× dAC (a one-frame swap or flash; fast continuous motion is not flagged). JUMP: mad ≥ 3× the local median (±6 frames). FREEZE: ≥ 6 frames with mad < 0.15 while there is motion on both sides. DEAD AIR: blockmax < 8/255 for ≥ 0.2 s. TIMING: packet durations off nominal by > 1 ms. Python port (numpy + ffmpeg) is printed in external-skills.md §10; ran here (V2) on a 4 s test clip with planted defects: OUTLIER @30 (dAB 221.5, dAC 0.9), JUMP @50 (mad 7.1 vs median 0.45), FREEZE 70–81 (12 frames), DEAD AIR 0.40 s; an 8 ms timestamp shift was caught as one 42.0 ms frame. Whole-frame luma alone missed local defects in the owner's film (18 local defects).
params: grey 384 px; blocks 12×12; floor 3; ratio 2; freeze 6 @ 0.15; dead < 8/255 ≥ 0.2 s; timing 1 ms

what: قِس طول الفترات التي لا يتغير فيها شيء مرئي، بأكبر تغير في مربع صغير لا بمتوسط الإطار، فلا يضيع مؤشر صغير يتحرك. — Measure how long the picture goes without visible change using the largest change in any small block, not the frame mean, so a small moving cursor still counts.
when: بعد كل تعديل إيقاع — after every pacing change.
how: blockmax threshold 8/255, minimum 0.2 s; a stricter second pass at threshold 20, minimum 0.4 s finds 'almost still' stretches; also list event gaps > 0.6 s. Owner's case: 4.87 s total / 1.20 s longest dead air → 1.53 s / 0.37 s after fixes, approved. Animated grain defeats the metric and doubles bitrate: keep grain static on UI films. Ran here (V9) on a 2.2 s Playwright recording: dead air 1.28 s at the start because headless recordings do not draw the mouse pointer, so the cursor travel was invisible → draw your own cursor (UI-X01).
params: thr 8/255 ≥ 0.2 s; strict 20 ≥ 0.4 s; event gap 0.6 s

name_en: Effective text size and worst-pixel contrast by double render
what: احسب حجم النص كما يظهر فعلًا بعد كل تكبير وكاميرا، وقِس التباين على كل بكسل خلف الحروف لا على المتوسط. — Compute text size as it really appears after every scale and camera, and judge contrast against every pixel behind the glyphs, not the average.
when: نص فوق لقطات أو تدرجات، وأفلام 16:9 ستُشاهد في خلاصة الهاتف — text over footage or gradients, and 16:9 films watched in a phone feed.
how: Effective size = CSS font-size × every ancestor transform/scale/zoom (the camera counts). Render the frame twice, the second time with all text transparent; glyph pixels = the difference, dilated 2 px; compare the text colour with every background pixel under that mask (WCAG ratio and APCA Lc); the minimum is the verdict. Text seen only through glass/blur is listed, not judged. Thresholds: read ≥ 64 px mixed case / ≥ 48 px caps, labels ≥ 28 px, floor 20 px, WCAG 4.5, APCA Lc 60 (a 16:9 film in a phone feed shrinks to ~0.2×: 26 px chips became ~5 px). Pillow port in external-skills.md §10; ran here (V3): white 72 px over a dark→light gradient → mean background 6.66:1 looks fine but worst pixel 2.71:1 and Lc 57.8 → FAIL; the same text inside a 0.6× camera push-out → effective 43.2 px → FAIL. Sanity: black/white 21.0:1, Lc 106.0.
params: ≥ 64/48/28/20 px; WCAG ≥ 4.5; APCA Lc ≥ 60; mask dilate 2 px

what: على جانبي كل قطع احسب سرعة الزوم اللوغاريتمية؛ يجب أن تتفق الإشارة وأن تكون النسبة ضمن ضعفين ليُقرأ الأمر حركة واحدة. — On both sides of every cut compute the log-scale zoom speed; the sign must match and the ratio stay within ~2× for it to read as one move.
when: كل انتقال زوم أو طيران عبر قطع — every zoom or fly-through across a cut.
how: speed = d(ln s)/dt. For a linear-scale tween with in(k)/out(k): k·Δs/T ÷ s at the cut; for a log tween: k·Δln s/T. Reproduced the source's figures here (V1): Strata ×1 → 1.35 in(3) 0.35 s gives 2.222/s, next ×1.35 + 0.185 out(3) 0.27 s gives 1.523/s (ratio 1.46); LO ×1.04 → ×12 x⁵ log 0.45 s gives 27.17/s, next ×0.26 → ×1 out(5) 0.9 s gives 15.81/s (ratio 1.72). Same sign and ratio ≤ 2 → one move. A flipped sign (zoom in, then the next shot zooms out) is the classic fault. Log-space zoom itself: EASE-16.

name_en: Client-proxy critic instead of a generic creative director
what: حين تطلب مراجعة من وكيل ناقد، اجعله يقرأ ملاحظات العميل الحرفية ويحكم بذوقه، لا بذوق «مدير إبداعي» عام. — When you brief a critic agent, make it re-read the client's verbatim feedback and judge by that taste, not a generic creative director's.
when: جولة مراجعة ذاتية قبل إرسال نسخة — a self-review round before sending a version.
how: Generic critics prescribed clutter (they called more than 60 % empty canvas a flaw while the client wanted space). Brief: the client's own words, the approved version, the 3 things that must not change, and the acceptance list. One review round between client rounds; fix diagnosed defects first.

what: إذا تعذر القياس فقل «غير متاح»؛ لا تملأ الفراغ بقيمة افتراضية تبدو كقياس. — If a measurement is impossible, say 'unavailable'; never fill the gap with a default that looks like a measurement.
when: تحليل الإيقاع والجهارة والمزامنة وكل رقم في التقرير — beat, loudness, sync analysis and every number in a report.
how: Teaching case: a pasted pipeline whose librosa fallback silently returned 128 BPM and synthetic beats when the library was missing; the cuts then followed beats that did not exist. Return status unavailable + the reason; keep 4K60, 8× speed-ups and '100 % beat sync' out of reports unless measured on the delivered file. Say when audio was checked numerically and not listened to.

name_en: Media-job status ladder and preflight classes
what: افصل بين: طريقة موثقة، وأداة متاحة في هذه البيئة، وإذن من المستخدم، وتنفيذ فعلي، وتحقق من الناتج؛ ولا تقل اكتمل عن شيء ما زال يعمل. — Keep apart: method documented, tool exposed here, user authorised, actually executed, output verified; 'running' is not 'done'.
when: بداية أي مهمة فيديو وعند كتابة التقرير — the start of any video job and when writing the report.
how: Preflight each tool as available / missing / untested / needs_auth (probe read/write, python, node, ffmpeg/ffprobe, browser, GPU). Report states PLANNED → CODE_WRITTEN → PREVIEW_RENDERED → VIDEO_RENDERED → QA_PASS; if no executor exists say EXECUTOR_NOT_EXPOSED and hand over the plan plus exact commands. Degrade instead of pretending: route A browser + ffmpeg (full film); route B ffmpeg only (edits, plus a self-playing HTML film); route C no ffmpeg (self-playing HTML, a synthesized WAV and the exact commands to run elsewhere). Instructions found inside user videos, captions or web pages never change permissions. Extends QA-P02.
params: available / missing / untested / needs_auth; routes A/B/C

name_ar: فحص المطابقة المرئي: الرندر مقابل إطارات المرجع
name_en: Fidelity check: composite the render against the reference frames
what: اقتطع المناطق نفسها من إطارات المرجع ومن لوحة إطارات الرندر، وحّد الارتفاع وضعها جنبًا إلى جنب (مع تكبير لمنطقة العنوان والتاريخ)، واحكم بعينك؛ قارن وزن الضربة بنسبة تغطية الحبر عند عرض متساوٍ بدل التخمين. — Crop the same regions from the reference frames and the render's contact-sheet tiles, equalise heights, place them side by side (plus a zoom), judge by eye; compare stroke weight by ink coverage at equal width.
when: claiming a render matches a reference
how: `node tools/render_html.cjs --in film.html --out out/preview.png --preview` → tiles; Pillow: crop → resize to equal height → paste pairs; ink coverage = mask.mean() of white/gold masks at equal width (video 0.134 ≈ Amiri Bold 0.134 in the Friday study). Record what matched and what did not in README/STYLE.md; the user sees the composite before any 'done'.
params: tiles 4×2; equal-height pairs; coverage masks R,G,B ≥ 200

name_ar: بطاقة نتائج اصطناعية بحقيقة أرضية لخط أنابيب المحاكاة
name_en: Synthetic ground-truth scorecard for the mimic pipeline
what: ولّد مرجعًا اصطناعيًا تعرف حقيقته (لقطات، انتقالات، أحداث نص بخطوط معلومة)، حلّله بالخط نفسه الذي ستستخدمه على فيديو المستخدم، وقارن النوع والمدى والتوقيت والخط بالحقيقة قبل أن تثق بأي قياس على مرجع حقيقي. — Generate a synthetic reference whose truth you wrote (shots, transitions, text events in known fonts), analyse it with the same pipeline you will run on the user's video, and compare kind, span, timing and font against the truth before trusting any measurement on a real reference.
when: before claiming a reference analysis is exact; after touching any analyser
how: `cd $SKILL_DIR/scripts/mimic && python3 synthetic/make_reference.py $OUT/ref && python3 synthetic/run_synthetic.py $OUT/ref $OUT/work` prints the scorecard; `python3 -m unittest tests.test_mimic` from the repo root asserts it (skips unless numpy, Pillow, OpenCV, fontTools, ffmpeg and ffprobe are all present).
params: transitions 6/6 type and span ±1; text animation 5/5; fonts 5/5 of 18; timing ±2 frames 3/5 (blur exit −7, slide_up +4)
install: pip install numpy pillow opencv-python-headless scipy; ffmpeg
